description: Rewrite the Product initialization and Product change-standardization Claude Skills and portable Prompts as paired English canonical instructions. They must read document_language and write durable Product knowledge in that language while conversing in the user's current language.
acceptance_criteria: Product initialization and change-standardization workflows use natural English canonical instructions
Both native Skills and portable Prompts read document_language before producing durable content
Chinese and English trigger examples remain discoverable without duplicating workflow bodies
Native and portable variants preserve equivalent questions routing boundaries and outputs
notes: Human review confirmed all acceptance criteria on 2026-08-26. Product initialization and Product change standardization now use canonical English instructions across paired Claude Skills and portable Prompts. Each pair has an exactly equivalent workflow body beneath its distribution-specific wrapper, while English and concise Chinese trigger examples remain discoverable. Both workflows read document_language before producing durable Product knowledge, keep conversation language transient, preserve stable protocol identifiers, and explicitly cover en/zh-CN mismatch scenarios. Fresh-context review restored the unconditional 2-4 choices plus custom-answer rule and the pre-existing Feature routing boundary: new modules and large refactors use generate-feature-list, while small existing-module changes and Product bugs use sync-feature-list. Code smell scan: pass (feature: F016, must_fix: 0, suggest: 1, acceptable: 3).
